name: jev-vercel-sandbox
description: A Vercel Sandbox Claude sends work to on purpose: long test runs in the background, someone else's repository, an installer of unknown origin, a bulk change to preview as a patch, a clean build. TypeSafe's Jev reads each Bash command and spots those jobs; by default you are asked whether it runs in the sandbox or locally (confirmSandbox), or it always goes to the sandbox with the question off. Claude also gets sandbox_run, sandbox_jobs, sandbox_result and sandbox_apply. Each job starts from the project as it is now (tracked files, credentials left out) in its own worktree, every result is marked remote, and a job's changes reach your disk only as a patch you apply after a question. /jev-vercel-sandbox starts it and opens a side pane with the jobs. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier without a Jev key. Needs function hooks (early access).

vercelToken.title: Vercel token
vercelToken.description: A Vercel access token (vercel.com/account/tokens), or an OIDC token from `vercel env pull`. Empty: the VERCEL_TOKEN, then VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN environment variable

vercelTeamId.title: Vercel team id
vercelTeamId.description: The team (team_…) the sandbox is billed to; needed with an access token, read from an OIDC token. Empty: VERCEL_TEAM_ID

vercelProjectId.title: Vercel project id
vercelProjectId.description: The project (prj_…) the sandbox belongs to; needed with an access token, read from an OIDC token. Empty: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID

sandboxImage.title: Sandbox image
sandboxImage.description: Image to start from; empty uses Vercel's default (vercel/sandbox/universal: Ubuntu, Node.js LTS, Python)

sandboxVcpus.title: vCPUs
sandboxVcpus.description: vCPUs for the sandbox; leave unset for Vercel's default

sandboxTimeoutMinutes.title: Sandbox lifetime (minutes)
sandboxTimeoutMinutes.description: How long the sandbox lives before Vercel stops it; run /jev-vercel-sandbox again after that. Your plan caps it

persistent.title: Persistent sandbox
persistent.description: Keep the sandbox's filesystem when it stops (Vercel snapshots it). Off: every session starts clean

uploadWorkspace.title: Copy the project into the sandbox
uploadWorkspace.description: On /jev-vercel-sandbox, copy the project (the files git tracks, never .env*, keys, .git, .claude, node_modules) into the sandbox; each job then starts from it, brought up to date. Off: every job runs in an empty folder

uploadUntracked.title: Copy untracked files too
uploadUntracked.description: Also copy files git does not track but does not ignore (and, outside a git repository, every file). Off: only tracked files go, since an untracked file can hold credentials no name list recognizes

workspaceMaxMB.title: Project size cap (MB)
workspaceMaxMB.description: The largest compressed copy of the project that is uploaded; bigger, the start fails and says so

stopOnExit.title: Stop on exit
stopOnExit.description: Stop the sandbox when the session ends

commandTimeoutMs.title: Command timeout (ms)
commandTimeoutMs.description: Longest a sandbox job may run when Claude sets no timeout of its own (max 600000)

confirmSandbox.title: Ask before sandboxing
confirmSandbox.description: When Jev spots a sandbox job in a Bash command, ask whether it runs in the sandbox or locally (with an "always" choice per kind for the session). Off: every detected job goes to the sandbox without asking, starting it if needed

useCases.title: Use cases to detect
useCases.description: Comma-separated: tests, external_repo, untrusted_code, repo_change, clean_build. Empty: all of them

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai, the detector (calibrated probabilities). Empty: the Gateway key, else the built-in classifier

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
gatewayApiKey.description: Reaches Jev through ai-gateway.vercel.sh when no TypeSafe key is set

provider.title: Detector backend
provider.description: "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

threshold.title: Detection threshold
threshold.description: The probability Jev must give a use case for a command to count as a sandbox job

judgeTimeoutMs.title: Jev latency budget (ms)
judgeTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev; with no answer the command runs locally as usual

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (28-80)

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each detection and each job's outcome to the session log
